# Superseded — do not edit

The canonical Privacy Policy is **`docs/index.html`**, published at
<https://revvapp.github.io/revvapp/>. That is the URL given to Apple and linked
from the app, so it is the only copy that can be authoritative.

This file previously held a second, Markdown copy of the policy. It had drifted
out of sync — it still carried unfilled `[insert ...]` placeholders while the
hosted page had real contact details, and it never received the 2026-08-05
updates covering email/SMS notifications, the SendGrid and Twilio processors,
vehicle data, or in-app account deletion.

Two copies of a legal document that disagree is worse than either alone, so the
Markdown copy was retired rather than updated. Its full text remains in git
history if it is ever needed.

Edit `docs/index.html`. See `PRIVACY_POLICY_DELTA.md` for what changed and why.
